---
title: "Problems and suggestions"
description: "How to report errors or make suggestions about the maps and the data."
---

If you find an error in the maps or in the data (a misplaced municipality, a wrong boundary, a wrong code...) or want to make a suggestion, please let me know. Your feedback helps improve the package.

## Form

Fill in the form and press **Send**: your e-mail program will open with the message ready, addressed to [pau.vall@ub.edu](mailto:pau.vall@ub.edu). You just need to send it.

```{=html}
<form id="mhist-form" class="mhist-form" onsubmit="return mhistSend(event)">
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="mf-type">Type</label>
    <select class="form-select" id="mf-type">
      <option>Problem</option>
      <option>Suggestion</option>
      <option>Question</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="mf-name">Name and affiliation (optional)</label>
    <input class="form-control" type="text" id="mf-name">
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="mf-where">Census, municipality or unit concerned (optional)</label>
    <input class="form-control" type="text" id="mf-where" placeholder="e.g. 1930, Los Altos (09014)">
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="mf-text">Description</label>
    <textarea class="form-control" id="mf-text" rows="7" required></textarea>
  </div>
  <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
<script>
function mhistSend(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  var type = document.getElementById("mf-type").value;
  var name = document.getElementById("mf-name").value;
  var where = document.getElementById("mf-where").value;
  var text = document.getElementById("mf-text").value;
  var subject = "[mapSpainHist] " + type + (where ? " - " + where : "");
  var body = "Type: " + type + "\n" +
             (name ? "Name: " + name + "\n" : "") +
             (where ? "Census / municipality: " + where + "\n" : "") +
             "\n" + text + "\n";
  window.location.href = "mailto:pau.vall@ub.edu?subject=" + encodeURIComponent(subject) +
                         "&body=" + encodeURIComponent(body);
  return false;
}
</script>
```

If the form does not open your e-mail program, you can write directly to [pau.vall@ub.edu](mailto:pau.vall@ub.edu).

## GitHub

If you have a GitHub account, you can also open an issue in the repository. Issues are public and you can follow how they are solved:

- [Report a problem](https://github.com/pauvallprat/mapSpainHist/issues/new?template=problem.yml)
- [Make a suggestion](https://github.com/pauvallprat/mapSpainHist/issues/new?template=suggestion.yml)
- [See open issues](https://github.com/pauvallprat/mapSpainHist/issues)
